assessmentScope: Fresh independent validation of the revision6 mockup/proof-surface incident closure only.

facts: Normal user-facing routes were tested separately from explicit proof queries.
Computed border/radius/shadow, visible captures, clipped screen geometry and reversible scroll were all verified; DOM class presence alone was not accepted.
Mobile and desktop proof canvases were measured against their true browser viewport and full-bleed section bounds.
Hero, News, TCG Live, Pocket, CTA and held-out controls were personally operated and restored.

evidenceFidelity.basis: The source Pocket section still renders the approved 720x464 background asset, 500x306 logo-cards composite, Kanit/PT Sans roles, white CTA, black-to-gold hover and external Pocket href. No image failed to load and no console warning/error appeared.

structuralFidelity.basis: Normal Home, Pocket Fixture and existing held-out each retain a visible rounded phone chassis plus independently scrollable clipped screen. Explicit mobile proof is exactly 390x844 with section x=0,width=390 and asset-first/copy-second geometry. Explicit desktop proof is x=0,width=1440 with a full-width background and a 720x356.5 inset black child. Removing the proof query restores the chassis.

generativeProof.basis: The labelled fictional Pocket Deck Studio fixture preserves the bounded black copy child, full-section campaign field, Kanit/PT Sans hierarchy and localized CTA while changing the message, asset construction and desktop child order. Its CTA changes/restores local state, and the separate Deck Lab held-out accordion also changes/restores without shell loss.
